approaches.title: Iterative linked-list digit addition
approaches.summary: Adds corresponding digits from both reverse-order linked lists in a single iterative traversal, propagating carry and constructing the result with a dummy head.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial iterative solution using a dummy head, separate carry handling, and optional-node value extraction.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2: fold last carry into the while loop
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Refactors carry handling into the loop condition and uses the ListNode constructor and and_then for traversal.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2: combine node value extraction and advance pointer
